meta.title: Scenario: messy survey (Lindenfield Practice)
meta.notes: Fictional data, generated by scripts/generate-merged-scenarios.ts (messy-survey) with seed 20261112. Partial response, asymmetric ratings and compressed ratings together, with a new joiner. 26 members in three teams. CLI08, LAB06, ADM04 did not respond and CLI02, LAB03, ADM07 answered about a third, so coverage sits just below the 80 % threshold. Response styles: CLI04, CLI06, CLI09, LAB02, LAB05, LAB08, ADM02, ADM05 avoid both ends of every scale; LAB07, ADM06 give everyone 3 and +1; ADM03 rates generously and LAB04 harshly; the rest use the whole scale. Members two or more levels junior rate seniors higher than seniors rate them. CLI03, CLI05, CLI06 and CLI08 have strained relationships with one another, but CLI06 never gives a negative rating and CLI08 did not respond. ADM09 joined last week, knows only their manager and marked valence “does not apply” for everyone else, as everyone else did for them. Five valence ratings were declined, and about 8 % of informal collaboration ratings are missing.
